about: Job 5 (Nov 11 2026): corridor-outline joins for the 39 wild and scenic river parks that have a saved river line but grade pin. NOTHING in this file is read by a key builder. status: staged-ready = passes the corridor rule below; 'entry.apply' is the exact data/us-key/overrides.json entry (the same form as the signed Kern / Tuolumne / Michigan river joins) to write once the overrides split lands, with 'decided_by' added by the owner; held = a person's hold (overrides none, needs-another-look.json) or a far-off pin, not lifted and not joined; needs-saved-copy = a corridor record may exist but the saved evidence does not show the whole river or any record (see 'needs'); left = checked, cannot be joined under the rule (pin test fails or no corridor polygon of its own). data/us-key/overrides.json is already over 1 MB, so this job did not edit it. No pin is changed anywhere.
rule: Job 5 corridor rule (Nov 11 2026; no looser than the signed Nov 9 river joins: their sure rule and whole-river rule): (1) the record is in a wild and scenic river CORRIDOR layer the US key reads (fwsr = USFS EDW WildScenicRiver_01, wsrc = NPS WildScenicRiverBoundaries, sgorg = BLM Oregon WSR corridors), never the forest / park / refuge / SRMA / ACEC / wilderness around it; (2) the record's own name is this river in this state; (3) the pin is inside or within 0.5 km of at least one joined record, by a distance the last key build or the nightly near-miss list measured on the saved copy; (4) every joined record is within 0.6 deg of the pin (the builder's join test); (5) whole river: every same-river corridor record in the evidence is joined, no saved compare says partial, and the joined acres (sum) are 0.5x-2x the saved official river line's miles x 320 ac/mi (the Act's average cap; 0.5x-2x is kpc_join_check.RATIO); (6) no person's hold (overrides none, needs-another-look.json) and no far-off pin (over 5 km from the saved official line, kpc_join_check.NEW_KM).
pin_test: Not repeatable here for the corridor polygons: their geometry is only in the per-state saved copies (cache/us/US-XX.json.gz), which are in neither checkout. Distances are the ones the last key build (Links data/us-key) and the nightly near-miss list (KPC-Data, measured on the saved copy) recorded. Pin-to-line distances were recomputed here from the saved official river lines.
how_to_apply: after the overrides split: for each staged-ready park, write entry.apply as parks[<ref>] in the overrides file, plus decided_by
run the US key for MI and OR (by hand or the monthly run), never while a key or 2-fer run is running
expect US-12788, US-10249 and US-10251 to grade official with these ids tagged reviewed
